proof: Full rank modulo 13 of the first six inverse-power columns follows from the verified unit-pivot inverse modulo 13^6, so H is onto the six mixed-modulus factors. Integer kernel index 13^21 equals abs(det U); all U rows satisfy H=0, hence equality.

Each atom x has integer coordinates and H(x)=target. Since B=13^6 annihilates the quotient, B*x*U^-1 is integral. Its coordinatewise remainder c modulo B gives exactly the affine coset of all integer u with this atom target. Signed sums of c give the same result for arbitrary positive/negative multisets. Verified all 156 atom targets independently using a fixed six-coordinate modular solver; includes q=13.

For z=c+B*n and u=zU/B, weighted squared norm is sum_i D_i*(z_i/B+sum_{j>i}mu[j][i]*z_j/B)^2. h=L_i*c_i+sum MM[i][j]*z_j, step=B*L_i, T_i=Q*D_i/step^2. The recurrence spent+T_i*(h+step*n_i)^2 is precisely Q times the nonnegative partial GS norm. Positive step and T_i imply pruning cannot remove a feasible completion.

For R^2<=2*CAP^2<min D, each allowed interval for n_i has radius strictly <1, so every feasible n_i is floor(-h/step) or that plus one. The two adjacent candidates and inclusive comparison e<=Q*R^2 cover the boundary. Descending induction establishes all lattice points in the ball are enumerated once for each representative.

With |mu[j][i]|<=1/2, every accepted prefix has |z_i|/B < 1+1/2 sum_{j>i}|z_j|/B <= (3/2)^(11-i). Both native long coordinate and adjacent candidate arithmetic fit signed 32-bit by the checked rational bound, including remainder and roster vector sums. GMP computes large Q,T,step,h,spent exactly. This bound is for the fixed frozen U and q13, not arbitrary inputs.

For a budget-valid u, positive and negative weighted residual masses fit CAP-cp and CAP-cn respectively. Sum of squared weights times u^2 is bounded by squared positive and negative masses, hence the search ball is a necessary condition. BRC common-label normalization lowers both cp and cn by the same nonnegative 13*sum(t-1), preserves signed atom difference and c, and expands the ball. Every original feasible solution maps to an enumerated representative. Restoring common labels and recalculating both side masses is required for exact witness classification.
